title: Relationship Combinations
description: Demonstrates all four combinations of cardinality × structure (§8.7). A single Employee type carries one property for each quadrant of the matrix: has-one vertical, has-many vertical, has-one horizontal, has-many horizontal.

Address.title: Address
Address.description: Embedded value object. No independent identity — exists only inside its owning Employee. Used as the target of a HAS-ONE VERTICAL relationship.

Badge.title: Badge
Badge.description: Embedded value object. Each Employee can carry multiple badges. Used as the item type of a HAS-MANY VERTICAL relationship.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Carries all four relationship patterns from §8.7 in a single type. address: HAS-ONE VERTICAL (embedded Address). badges: HAS-MANY VERTICAL (embedded Badge array). departmentId: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL (Department referenced by ID). projectIds: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL (Projects referenced by ID array).

address.description: HAS-ONE VERTICAL (§8.7, §8.8): the Address object is embedded directly in this Employee's JSON and validated as part of it. The Address has no existence outside this document.

badges.description: HAS-MANY VERTICAL (§8.7, §8.8): each Badge is embedded directly in this Employee's JSON. Zero or more badges are allowed.

departmentId.description: HAS-ONE HORIZONTAL (§8.7, §8.9): references the owning Department by its identifier. The Department object is NOT embedded — it lives in a separate document or data store.

projectIds.description: HAS-MANY HORIZONTAL (§8.7, §8.9): references zero or more Projects by their identifiers. Project objects are NOT embedded.
